title: EKCD: An EKC-derived Ontology for Korean Cultural Heritage Knowledge Modeling
description: EKCD is an EKC-derived ontology in OWL/Turtle for Korean cultural heritage knowledge modeling, with a particular focus on historical and cultural resources of Korea. It provides additional datatype properties for dates and URLs, local application guidelines for standard semantic mapping properties, and project-level semantic extensions while preserving conceptual continuity with the EKC ontology line. Version 1.2.0 is a non-breaking vocabulary-expansion and semantic-model refinement release. It separates interpretive basis from epistemic confidence in the EKCD interpretive-assertion model, deprecates the legacy mixed values Direct, Probable, and Contextual for new data, and clarifies the methodological relationship to CRMinf without introducing a formal CRMinf dependency or alignment.

notes: EKCD imports and derives from the EKC ontology line. The EKC Vocabulary Contributor Group is acknowledged for its contribution to the source/imported EKC vocabulary; this acknowledgement does not imply that all members of the group directly contributed to EKCD. Among members of the EKC Vocabulary Contributor Group, direct EKCD work has been carried out by Dong Shin SEO and Su-jeong PARK.
